name: pooled-top1-hierarchical-shrunk-prototypes-on-exact-vicreg-c1
purpose: Test one isolated training-free model factor: spherical shrinkage of exact C1 class prototypes toward the fold-train global centroid.
hypothesis: A fixed global-centroid shrinkage prior suppresses spurious matches to noisy low-support prototypes and improves pooled OOF top-1 while preserving the replicated C1 gain.
symmetric_risk: For a class with n_y=2, lambda=8 makes its unnormalized candidate prototype 80 percent global centroid; this can rotate neighboring rare classes toward one another, erase distinctiveness, and increase their confusion.
claim_domain: pooled OOF top-1 only; macro and support-stratum results are mandatory descriptive diagnostics and may not replace the frozen primary claim

v17_2_erratum.rule: cache declarations below are generated from and must exactly equal the canonical i5 enforcement constants before this spec is accepted

arms.baseline: Persisted B0 top-k rows from v9, used only for the unchanged mission anchor.
arms.control: Exact C1 readout from the persisted fold/seed projection checkpoint: post-L2 train embeddings, class chordal mean mu_y, then normalize(mu_y).
arms.candidate: The same persisted C1 embeddings and OOF queries with only the class prototype replaced by normalize((n_y * mu_y + 8 * mu_G) / (n_y + 8)).

changed_factor.lambda_type: single fixed scalar shared by every fold, seed, and class
changed_factor.train_embeddings: persisted C1 checkpoint applied to cached base train features; ProjectionHead output is post-L2 normalized
changed_factor.oof_embeddings: same persisted C1 checkpoint applied to cached base OOF features; unchanged between control and candidate
changed_factor.mu_y: arithmetic mean of all post-L2 normalized fold-train embeddings whose class label is y
changed_factor.n_y: fold-local count of the same rows used in mu_y
changed_factor.mu_G: arithmetic mean of all post-L2 normalized fold-train embeddings across every class, including y
changed_factor.similarity: dot product between post-L2 OOF embeddings and normalized prototypes

failure_interpretation: If minimally supported strata regress, state that shrinkage cost exceeded its variance benefit on minimal-support classes; do not replace the frozen pooled-top1 claim with macro or subgroup selection.
